summary:
- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#561](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/561)** — The handling of HTCondor Log and Output files in `run_analysis.py` / `run_fccanalysis.py` was adjusted so that HTCondor warnings about log file placement no longer trigger ten spurious retry submissions, preventing duplicated job clusters for pre-edm4hep1 stack users.
- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)** — The ML inference model is now initialized before the event loop rather than lazily inside `runInference`, the geometry initialization was moved late enough for DD4hep settings to be available, the interface concepts were completed, and the default was switched to non-hadron showers.
- **[key4hep/DDML#17](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/17)** — A basic runtime test suite using CaloClouds3 was added to verify end-to-end execution; a latent reference-counting issue uncovered in `TorchInference` was worked around by leaking a resource, deferring the proper fix.
- **[key4hep/DDML#18](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/18)** — The example CaloClouds3 ddsim steering configuration was corrected to use the proper model for the Endcap.
- **[key4hep/DDML#20](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/20)** — The ONNX and Torch inference backends were fixed to copy only the number of elements the model actually returned into the output buffer, instead of unconditionally memcpy-ing the full buffer capacity and reading garbage past the real data.
- **[key4hep/DDML#31](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/31)** — The custom `FindOnnxRuntime.cmake` module was removed in favour of the `onnxruntime::onnxruntime` CMake target shipped by newer onnxruntime; this effectively mandates onnxruntime ≥ 1.16.
- **[key4hep/DDML#34](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/34)** — A new BIBAE two-angle model was added for retrieval via `ExternalData`, extending the catalogue of pre-trained generative shower models available to users.
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#525](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/525)** — Include-what-you-use suggestions were applied across headers, utility code, tests, and tools, with manual follow-up cleanup to reduce transitive include fan-out.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)** — Boolean Gaudi properties can finally be switched off from the `k4run` command line: a dedicated parser now accepts `True/False`, `true/false`, `1/0`, treats a bare flag as `True`, and rejects anything else, fixing cases where `bool("False")` incorrectly evaluated to `True` both when the property was set in the options file and when it was left at its default `propertyNoValue`.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#436](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/436)** — The minimum Gaudi requirement was bumped to v41r1 for the EventContext data-handle API, which did not make it into v41r0.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#437](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/437)** — The k4FWCore Python package is now installed to `${GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR}` rather than a hardcoded `python/` directory, aligning with the Gaudi v41r0 layout change that places Python under `lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages`; without this, nothing using `IOSvc` could run after the Gaudi update.
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)** — The `DelphesEDM4HepConverter` was changed to assume the pion mass in the energy calculation for all tracks that are not electrons or muons, ensuring mass/energy/momentum consistency, and now writes an explicit PDG ID for tracks and leptons so analysts no longer need to infer particle identity from the mass; a jet-mass/energy consistency check and a lepton-charge test were added.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/97)** — A `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` CMake flag (default `ON`) was added to gate the FCCee tracking components so the package can be built in the Muon Collider stack, which does not ship Marlin/LCIO; downstream Spack and lcgcmake recipes will need matching updates.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)** — Several correctness fixes landed in `GenfitTrackFitter`: units in the helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and the `z0` conversion were corrected, a singular initial covariance when the seed is near the reference point was prevented, EDM4hep track states are now built using GENFIT's native extrapolation to the point of closest approach, and the AtFirstHit/AtLastHit states use the first and last digitised hits as references.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#106](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/106)** — The deprecated `getTrackState(int32_t)` overload was replaced in `TrackMerger` by the new `edm4hep::TrackState::Location`-enum-based API, clearing deprecation warnings and tracking the EDM4hep#493 interface change.
- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#285](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/285)** — onnxruntime ≥ 1.16.0 is now required and the custom `FindONNXRuntime.cmake` plus its fallback for older versions were removed, aligning with the DDML and k4RecTracker changes.
- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)** — The deprecated `inputReader` Python module was removed; it relied on `PodioInput`, which is gone from k4FWCore and will no longer work in the upcoming release. Users should switch to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.
- **[key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv#135](https://github.com/key4hep/k4EDM4hep2LcioConv/pull/135)** — Obsolete EDM4hep version guards were removed from the conversion and comparison code, and the CMake build was updated to require EDM4hep ≥ 1.0.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#110](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/110)** — Data retrieval for tracking geometry and material-map files was switched from a wget-based `download_files.sh` script to CMake `ExternalData`, standardising large data handling with the rest of Key4hep (although the author noted the `.md5` files were not committed as expected).
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#929](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/929)** — A `tracking` variant was added to the `k4rectracker` Spack recipe to drive the new `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` flag, and the base spec was renamed to `main`.
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#930](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/930)** — The `k4_local_repo` setup used by nightlies and releases was updated for the Gaudi 41 install layout: `PYTHONPATH` now includes `install/lib(64)/pythonX.Y/site-packages` and `GAUDI_PLUGIN_PATH` includes `install/lib(64)/gaudi-plugins`, with a duplicated line in `setup-releases.sh` removed.
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#931](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/931)** — A `+cuda` variant was added to `k4actstracking` to propagate CUDA configuration to its stack dependencies.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)** — An IDEA option-2 full-simulation reconstruction configuration and CTest were added under `FCCee/FullSim/IDEA/IDEA_o2_v01/`, bringing option 2 up to parity with the IDEA option-1 reconstruction setup (vertex/silicon wrapper digitisers, tracking, calorimetry).
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#400](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/400)** — A new EvtGen decay card `Lb2L1520NuNu.dec` was added for `Lambda_b0 → Lambda(1520)0 νν̄` with `Lambda(1520)0 → p K⁻` (plus charge conjugate), tested with 200 events on the winter2023 stack.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#665](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/665)** — The IDEA_o1_v03 example steering file now sets the DD4hep worker event-sharing flag to `false` when running single-threaded, working around AIDASoft/DD4hep#1677 while remaining backwards compatible.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#667](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/667)** — The `dd4hep2root.py` XML-to-ROOT conversion was fixed so that the cached-colour lookup actually prevents re-approximating pre-defined ROOT colours (previously every colour was in the cache, so the shortcut was never taken), along with a minor `IDEA_o1_v01.xml` fix.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#668](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/668)** — The `dd4hep2root` utility is now exposed when sourcing a Key4hep environment, making the XML-to-ROOT geometry conversion directly usable without extra setup.
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1684](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1684)** — The EDM4hep file reader was changed to use the end vertex of the parent-less particle (defaulting to (0,0,0) when absent), matching the HepMC3 reader so that Pythia → ddsim results are consistent whether HepMC or EDM4hep is used as the intermediate format.
- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf#16](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/16)** — Depth was promoted from a configuration-file property to a CLI argument to enable full-detector conversion, remaining config properties were renamed, and the shipped config files for ALLEGRO, CLD, IDEA, and ILD_FCCee were updated accordingly.
- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf#17](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/17)** — An option was added to assign random colours to volumes whose colour is undefined, black, or white, along with an option to apply decreasing opacity (so outer layers are more transparent than inner ones), with the shipped FCC config files updated to expose the new properties.
- **[hep-fcc/phoenix-at-fcc#28](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/phoenix-at-fcc/pull/28)** — The Phoenix-at-FCC viewer gained a dedicated ILD_FCCee detector component with logo and bundled updated glTF assets, including new entries for ALLEGRO_o2_v01, CLD_o2_v08, CLD_o3_v01, CLD_o4_v05, IDEA_o1_v04, and IDEA_o2_v01, plus coloured-with-transparency renders of previously grey volumes.
